description: Edit a traffic light phase duration using netedit. The netedit application is already open with the Bologna Acosta network loaded (/home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/acosta_buslanes.net.xml). This is a real-world road network from the Acosta area in Bologna, Italy. Your task is to: 1. Switch to the Traffic Light mode by pressing 'T' or clicking the traffic light icon in the toolbar. 2. Click on any traffic-light-controlled junction (the intersections shown as colored circles with green/yellow/red dots). 3. In the traffic light editor panel on the left, you will see a phase table with columns for 'dur' (duration) and 'state'. Click on the first phase (row 0) to select it, then click on its duration cell and change the value to 45 seconds. 4. Press Enter to confirm the edit. The phase table should now show 45 as the first phase duration. 5. Save the traffic light program by pressing Ctrl+Shift+K or going to File > Traffic Lights > Save TLS Programs, and save it to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/modified_tls.xml.
